_about: T911 placeholder, filled by a later harvest. Per destination id: {neighbourhood name as in sleep.neighbourhoods[].name: [codes]}, codes from central, nightlife, quiet, families, food, budget. build_dossier.py merges them as sleep.neighbourhoods[i].suits, matching names with accents and case folded. Porto is the worked example (Bonfim borders the centre and has a growing food scene; Lordelo do Ouro e Massarelos is the residential riverside west by the Crystal Palace gardens).
